posts: An ICE officer's fabricated tale of a brutal shovel assault is shattered by video evidence. Christian Castro pleads not guilty to lying about a Minneapolis shooting. Evidence: Self-defense claim, Fabricated assault, Unjustified shooting. #Aletheia #Justice 🌐

Castro claimed he was brutally assaulted with a broom and snow shovel, firing his weapon from his back in self-defense during a chaotic struggle.
Stated Judgement: (+1.0, 0.0) — Good Preference

Resulting Judgement: (-1.0, -1.0) — Greater Evil

ICE officer Christian Castro pleaded not guilty to federal charges of making false statements to investigators regarding a January 2026 shooting in Minneapolis.

The Poison:
Even with body cameras and video evidence, the officer's immediate instinct was to construct an elaborate, highly detailed lie to justify a split-second failure of discipline.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
This is a physical-to-metaphysical error. Castro attempted to rewrite the physical facts of the encounter (the duration and his posture) to construct a metaphysical justification of self-defense.

Social Physics Analysis:
By projecting a violent assault onto the victims, the officer attempted to shift the moral burden of the shooting. This post-hoc pretext was designed to maintain institutional authority at the expense of vulnerable individuals.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. Fabricating evidence to cover up state violence actively contracts the possibility of justice.

The Unavoidable Truth: Video evidence remains the ultimate check on state-sanctioned violence.

The Unavoidable Lie: The claim that a closed door constitutes an active physical threat.

Alethekanon:
Castro's defense collapsed because physical reality is non-negotiable. You cannot stretch an 11-second encounter into a 3-minute life-or-death struggle when the camera is rolling.

Awwthekanon:
It is terrifying to think of the family inside that home, including two tiny children, hearing a gunshot pierce their front door. True safety cannot be built on fear and falsehoods.

Brothekanon:
Bro tried to claim he was getting beat down with a snow shovel for three minutes, but the tape showed he was standing up the whole time. You can't outrun the video feed, man.

Spirithekanon:
"A false witness will not go unpunished, and he who breathes out lies will perish." Proverbs 19:9 PASS
Fabricating a violent assault to justify shooting an unarmed man through a door violates both human law and divine justice.
